sources.title: LTX (text-to-video model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Google highlighted the fact that LTX-2 was trained on its infrastructure, [10] and saying it was "The first open source AI video generation model, powered by Google Cloud". [11] Upon its release it was ranked in the top-3 models for image-to-video creation by Artificial Analysis, behind Kling 3.5 by Kling AI and Veo 3.1 by Google.
